name: @work-address/identity
description: Builds, presents and checks Work Address profile commitments (profile schema v1), and verifies them, origin certificates and settlement receipts against a chain with nothing but an RPC endpoint. Browser-safe. Unaudited.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit
